SELECT
    OCR_PAGE_ID,
    JOB_ID,
    DOCUMENT_ID,
    PAGE_NUMBER,
    STATUS,
    OCR_TEXT,
    AVG_CONFIDENCE,
    OCR_ENGINE,
    PROCESSING_TIME_MS,
    CREATED_AT,
    UPDATED_AT,
    JOB_STATUS
FROM
(
    SELECT
        RAWTOHEX(p.OCR_PAGE_ID) AS OCR_PAGE_ID,
        RAWTOHEX(p.JOB_ID) AS JOB_ID,
        RAWTOHEX(p.DOCUMENT_ID) AS DOCUMENT_ID,
        p.PAGE_NUMBER,
        p.STATUS,
        p.OCR_TEXT,
        p.AVG_CONFIDENCE,
        p.OCR_ENGINE,
        p.PROCESSING_TIME_MS,
        p.CREATED_AT,
        p.UPDATED_AT,
        j.STATUS AS JOB_STATUS,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.PAGE_NUMBER
            ORDER BY p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.OCR_PAGE_ID DESC
        ) AS RN
    FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_DOCUMENT_OCR_PAGE p
    JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_DOCUMENT_OCR_JOB j
        ON j.JOB_ID = p.JOB_ID
    WHERE j.DOCUMENT_ID =
        HEXTORAW(
            REPLACE('{{JS_Document.getDocumentId()}}', '-', '')
        )
)
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY PAGE_NUMBER
